name: CheckPeople
instructions: Open https://checkpeople.com/opt-out and follow the site's steps for {full_name}. Use {contact_email} wherever it asks for an email address, so the reply is matched. Then press "I've done this".
notes: The site emails a link first; the link opens the next step, which asks for a date of birth and legal name and then shows records to pick. Removal takes 5 to 7 days. compliance@checkpeople.com takes requests by email.
source: Process per redact.dev's CheckPeople removal guide (updated 2026-10-05).
